audit.whatIsWrong: The Akali packet gives 49.68% over 777 games; the mirror entry pantheon__akali.json records that its packet says 53.54% while MC_WR_TABLES.pantheon on disk carries 50.32 for akali. Three different numbers for one matchup.
audit.why: MC_WR_TABLES is off-limits and I will not guess which row is the Emerald+ headline, so no chart, side, rating or diffRating was touched on this side either. The stage pattern itself (Pantheon at 1 and 6, Akali from 3 and from first item) is consistent across both layers and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes read 'Shield Vault online, level 6, first item' with no numbers and gave Akali 'levels 2-3'. Grand Starfall is named nowhere.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is not learnable before level 3. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range - the longest cooldown in the matchup, and it means his level 6 is a threat to the rest of the map rather than to you in lane, which changes what you do about it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why rebuilt on level 3 and the 180s global.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault carries no cooldown anywhere, and the full layer repeatedly says to 'Shroud-dodge' Shield Vault.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a targeted dash - the content layer says correctly that it ignores invisibility - so telling the player to shroud-dodge it in the full layer is the opposite advice on the same page. And Aegis Assault is 22/21/20/19/18s of front-facing invulnerability: it is the longest basic cooldown either champion has, it eats a committed Akali combo whole, and the _missing file flags this matchup untargetable-dodges-burst on exactly that ability. Neither number appeared.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0].t, winCon, report[1].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1], report[11].t, phases[1].why and content whys[1], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1] now carry the 13s Shield Vault and the 22s Aegis Assault, and the shroud-dodge instruction is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers appeared anywhere in either layer, and the content layer only calls Shield Vault 'a long cooldown early'.
audit.why: 13/12/11/10/9s is the number the whole plan hangs on: the lane is 'commit while his W is down', and 13 seconds is short enough that the player needs to know it is a bait window and not a rest.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, winCon, report[1].t, report[9].t and phases[1].why now state it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Sit low for his W execute' with a body about burning a cooldown.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a dash-stun; nothing in Riot's text makes it an execute, and the body belonged to another slot entirely.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].t and .d now describe bursting into Aegis Assault, which is the mistake that actually costs you the trade.
